text_block_list.text: The day of the Mainichi Okan is here.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Just before the race starts, Special
Week
approaches Сайленс Судзука with
messages from
both Эль Кондор Паса and
Grass Wonder.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Her fellow racers' impassioned messages
energize
Сайленс Судзука, and she steps
onto the track with
her head held high.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
